note: Predicted signatures locked BEFORE E1 runs, so the M4 verdict is matched-filtering, not post-hoc pattern reading (spec §5, plan A2). Do not edit predictions after seeing sweep data; a changed prediction is a new prereg version.

hardness_direction.convention: Resolution REFUTATION hardness (Ben-Sasson–Wigderson width bound): hardness peaks just above the sat threshold and falls as α rises.
hardness_direction.prediction: All shattering signatures intensify as α DECREASES toward threshold (opposite the solution-space dial).

predicted_signatures.H1_success_rate: Sharp collapse boundary as α decreases toward threshold — not smooth decay.
predicted_signatures.overlap_distribution: Unimodal on easy (high-α) cells; splits BIMODAL on hard (low-α) cells. Estimator: ±1-spin overlap q=(1/N)Σ v_i^a v_i^b, Pearson-normalized for soft membership vectors (I2).
predicted_signatures.hessian_spectrum: Top eigenvalues grow / minima sharpen and isolate as α decreases toward threshold.
predicted_signatures.failure_vs_success_loss: Failure losses plateau FAR from valid (needle-no-shadow), not hugging success losses.
predicted_signatures.trajectory_lensing_E5: Deceleration zones + inter-seed scattering increase as α decreases toward threshold; trajectories on easy (high-α) cells flow smooth and parallel.

controls.planted_positive_E0: Random-init verifier-pass rate ≥ 80% at n=20 (findability). Any verifying refutation counts, not recovery of the specific planted proof (C1).
controls.sat_negative: Pipeline on satisfiable instances: zero decodes verify (verifier is the backstop, A1).
controls.glitch_instrument_noise: Full pipeline + identical annealing on EASY (high-α, small-n) cells; any clustering/bimodality there is instrument artifact, catalogued and subtracted everywhere else.

hard_negatives.expected_behavior: No short Resolution proof exists — the relaxation is EXPECTED to FAIL to find a verifying refutation within budget L; that failure is the correct reading, predicted here (C2).

claim_standard.concordance_rule: Shattering is claimed ONLY if the overlap, Hessian, and failure-loss channels independently agree, AFTER subtracting the glitch catalog. Any single-channel signal is reported as an anomaly, not a finding (spec §5).
claim_standard.kill_no_signal: Smooth decay toward threshold + unimodal overlap + failure-loss hugging success-loss → negative result written as a short note, stop (spec §6.2).
